ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone, in Memories: start an entry, tap the tag in the corner of its dateline, pick a type, keep typing, tap Done; then More on that entry, Type, another one. On a walk: tap the note button, choose a type on the page before writing, write, Done. **Expect:** nothing about a type shows before the first character; the tap on the tag turns the bar into one row of eight with the keyboard still up, and a pick puts the bar back with the caret still in the entry; the next key typed puts the bar back too; the glyph sits in the entry's corner afterwards; More's Type shows the eight and No type in the same sheet; the walk's note is kept with the type chosen before its words, and a page left empty keeps nothing. Never run on a device: focus held across the tap on the slot. (note types NY18-NY25)
